findings.why: Board aliases, on-board parts and defaults are unknown, so they are not checked.
findings.fix: use canonical GPIO names, or add chipdata/boards/esp32-s3-devkitc-1.yaml.

findings.message: cannot resolve board alias 'LED_RGB': there is no board data for 'esp32-s3-devkitc-1'
findings.why: Without the GPIO number no pin rule can check this connection.
findings.fix: write the GPIO name (e.g. GPIO38) or set a board with board data.

findings.message: hc-sr04 echo drives 5 V or more into GPIO16 (community source)
findings.why: esp32s3 pins accept at most 3.6 V; a direct connection can damage it.
findings.fix: add a voltage divider or a level shifter, or use a 3.3 V part.
